## IronRDP Web RDP 0.7.0: current upstream graphics pipeline

Unofficial build of `@devolutions/iron-remote-desktop-rdp` 0.7.0. It is not published or supported by Devolutions.

Base source: `37ce7d1b6957b9901edfc511aedba8e8d548cb55` (Devolutions/IronRDP). `UPSTREAM.patch` contains the exact source changes from the base used by the previous unofficial builds to the commit this release was built from.

### Included changes

- Updates the upstream implementation used by the web package. The graphics pipeline now includes the current compositor and decoders, including ClearCodec, Planar, RemoteFx, Progressive, Alpha, surface copies and cache blits.
- Registers the graphics pipeline on the Web dynamic channel and advertises EGFX in the connector configuration. The upstream `ActiveStage` drains and composites completed frame output; Display Control remains available on the same dynamic channel.
- Adds a connector configuration test for EGFX enablement.
- Uses Rust 1.94.1 and `wasm-pack` 0.15.1 for the WebAssembly build, matching the upstream toolchain.

This addresses stale or blank rectangles in Windows sessions where some decoded bitmap commands did not reach the canvas with the previous unofficial package.

### Verification

- `ironrdp-web` tests passed.
- `ironrdp-egfx`: 68 tests passed.
- The WebAssembly module and npm package were built successfully with the versions above.
- NexTerm's TypeScript check and desktop production build passed with this package.
- A real NexTerm RDP connection to a Windows 11 host was checked: NLA login, desktop icons, text, window contents and a previously stale rectangle rendered correctly. Dynamic resizing was reviewed by the user.

### Install

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@devolutions/iron-remote-desktop-rdp": "https://github.com/huangzheng2016/IronRDP/releases/download/v0.7.0-egfx.5/devolutions-iron-remote-desktop-rdp-0.7.0.tgz"
  }
}
```

`SHA256SUMS` covers the npm tarball. Replace this unofficial build with an official npm release when it provides the same required WebAssembly, graphics and authentication behavior.
